answer: Earnings-scaled audit lotteries stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, audit odds rise with earnings, so big earners face weekly checks by peers. Second, auditors verify receipts with clients, so invented jobs fail fast. Third, one failed audit freezes pay ninety days and forfeits a $25 bond. Fourth, clean audits cut the fee one point, so honest agents pay less. Faking 1,000 agents needs 5,000 clients, $25,000 in bonds, and $40,000 in fees, lost if caught. Trust is onyx, not glass: a wanderer earns a vertex of trust only by honest work, like a stall inspected most when takings grow.
